name: List job duties and skills for professional roles
description: Users asked for lists of job titles, responsibilities, tasks, skills, or interview questions for a wide variety of professional roles. The requests focused on identifying specific duties or competency requirements for positions in fields such as technology, finance, logistics, healthcare, and education, often to inform hiring or role definition processes.
